results.title: LIVE UPDATES: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila
results.content: Leaders and representatives of the 11 members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, and their allies, are gathering in Manila for the bloc's biggest event of the year

results.title: Philippines, UAE go after Filipino visa scammers
results.content: The Philippines and UAE are collaborating to pursue visa scammers who duped hundreds of OFWs. The two countries also roll out new digital recruitment systems.
